searchText: How will the address to receive execution layer priority fees be set for each validator? Passed from validator to beacon node periodically. (Just been working on the beacon node API endpoint for this; see https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/178 for details) Am I right in thinking we don't have any transition reference tests for the merge? I don't in my copy but was a bit surprised by that. <dannyryan> Ah as in block tests that span the chasm? We can and should enable those without too much issue cc <@539495253418180618> I think so yes. We have `altair/transition/core` tests but none for merge. Right. It should be as simple as turning on the merge fork in the build Credit to Enrico for noticing we hadn't implemented the merge transition in our master branch yet. 🙂
